task.title: M2: Vite UI shell with ref picker and POST /api/analyze
task.description:
Create the packages/web Vite + TypeScript app and its first feature, the ref picker. The picker lists cached SHAs, branches, and tags, with unanalyzed refs shown in a visibly distinct state; selecting one triggers analysis through POST /api/analyze on the server and shows progress until the snapshot is available. Add the /api/analyze endpoint to serve, which runs the same analyze pipeline as the CLI and streams or polls status. The shell establishes the data-source abstraction (live API now, static JSON later for export) so one code path serves both.

Acceptance criteria:
- bun run build in packages/web produces assets that serve embeds; bun run dev proxies /api to a running serve.
- Ref picker groups cached, branches, and tags; unanalyzed entries are styled distinctly and show the language tier badges for analyzed ones.
- Choosing an unanalyzed ref POSTs /api/analyze { ref }, shows a spinner, and swaps in the snapshot when done; errors are shown inline.
- A DataSource interface with two implementations (api, static) is in place and the UI only talks to that interface.
- POST /api/analyze rejects concurrent duplicate requests for the same ref and returns 409.
